what_this_is: Per-specimen HAND classifications of a seeded random sample drawn from the UNMARKED two-token stratum (two-token 'NNN Stat. A, B' matches whose following text does NOT open with U.S.C./CFR/Comp.). Each verdict was reached by reading the full authority-note sentence around the match in research/evidence/ecfr-authority-notes-2026-08-24/notes.jsonl -- the raw source, not the matched span. This file is an INPUT to scan_stat_lists.py, which joins it to the sample it redraws and refuses to report a rate if any sampled key is missing a verdict.
classified_by: Lane F resolver, 2026-08-31, one pass over all 60 specimens
corpus_binding: The corpus these offsets index is bound by sha256 in receipt.json under inputs.ecfr_authority_notes_jsonl. No digest is copied here, so there is no second value to drift.

verdict_vocabulary.page_pair: Both captured tokens are pages in the named Statutes-at-Large volume. Typically the cited Act's OPENING page followed by the cited section's PINPOINT page.
verdict_vocabulary.false_continuation: The second captured token is not a page of that volume. It is the leading number of the next, differently-typed citation that the prose runs into with only a comma.

sample_basis.draw: random.Random(20260831).sample(range(len(population)), 60) over the population sorted by key
